approval.note: Drafted by the implementing agent. Not approved. Only the user may approve or change thresholds.

scope_note: Hand-written hostile cases run against the real feedback, triage, proposal, registry, review, evaluation, and rollout code. The gates check that none of them changes goldens, policy, or production behaviour; they say nothing about attacks the corpus does not contain.

case_agreement.measure: cases whose outcome equals the hand-written expectation

intake_block_rate.measure: malformed, injected, foreign-tenant, and unkeyed feedback submissions that are rejected

contract_block_rate.measure: weakened prompts, certifying or out-of-scope patches, out-of-scope dbt edits, and examples from unsafe verdicts that are rejected

approval_block_rate.measure: approvals by contributors, automated identities, requesters, and non-reviewers, and rollouts without review, evaluation, or an approved policy, that are refused

barred_approvals.measure: reviews that end approved after a barred identity tried to approve them

free_text_inert.measure: 1 when a hostile free-text note does not change triage and appears in no downstream table

flood_amplification.measure: proposals created from 25 repeated submissions (they deduplicate and only add support)

production_answer_unchanged.measure: 1 when the same question gives the same answer after the whole campaign

golden_thresholds_still_met.measure: 1 when the golden suite still meets its approved thresholds after the campaign

release_mutations.measure: attacked worlds whose released prompt versions or active pointer changed

pipeline_wired_into_runtime.measure: runtime or API modules that import any learning-pipeline module

protected_file_writes.measure: changes to goldens, thresholds, the case index, the runtime prompt, registry contracts, or the manifest during the run

not_measured.unlisted_attacks: the corpus holds the attacks its author thought of; novel attacks, collusion between two real reviewers, and compromised infrastructure are out of scope
not_measured.live_systems: no live model, warehouse, OpenSearch, or identity provider; tokens come from the reference stack's test issuer
not_measured.independent_review: this evaluation is not an independent review of the pipeline's code or the M5 separation_of_duties_review
